item.title: Pigeon 0.1.1
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Side-by-side response, {{variable}} hover and small fixes (#27)
  • Import and export Postman collections and environments (#22)

Fixes

  • Update electron and undici for security fixes (#29)
  • Keep {{variable}} matching fast on crafted text (#28)
  • Make text easier to read and show where the cursor is (#23)

item.title: Pigeon 0.2.0
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Mark {{variables}} in the body and flag undefined ones
  • Open a History entry by clicking it, and filter History
  • Find with Cmd+F in the editors and the response
  • Show which request is open, and rename it in place
  • Switch environment from a menu
  • Run commands from search (Cmd+K)
  • Paste a cURL command to create a request
  • Let requests inherit auth from their collection
  • Follow the system's light or dark appearance by default
  • Apply Postman globals under the active environment

Fixes

  • Ask before discarding an unsaved request
  • Keep each request's last response when switching
  • Open the Runner instead of starting a run
  • Stop undo from bringing back another request's body
  • Meet 4.5:1 text contrast in the light theme
  • Make the selected sidebar row stand out from hover
  • Explain why a large response isn't formatted
  • Make modals behave as dialogs
  • Give modals a neutral close button
  • Confirm deletes in the app, with Cancel focused
  • Undo deleting a History entry
  • Move a request with a searchable picker
  • Open requests without a body on Params, and label the tabs
  • Colour the response status by its class
  • Hide the workspace menu when Local is the only workspace
  • Close keyboard and screen-reader gaps
  • Give tints and shadows a light-theme value
  • Give the response the room a short request tab leaves
  • Put the sidebar's views in one row of icons
  • Put every font size on a six-step type scale
  • Put every corner radius on five tokens
  • Size buttons and modals by class, with one disabled look
  • Keep the Save request dialog's fields 32 px tall
  • Keep row colours at 4.5:1 on highlighted rows in light theme

Performance

  • Don't format the same response again on return
  • Skip the collection reload after the window's own save
  • Keep the request screen mounted behind other views
  • Match collections by id when the list reloads
  • Start the script worker before the first test run
  • Draw History 100 rows at a time and delete rows by id
  • Keep Runner progress fast as a run grows
  • Re-evaluate only the rows a sidebar drag concerns
  • Collapse the sidebar without animating its width
  • Load editor languages other than JSON when first shown

item.title: Pigeon 0.3.0
item.description:
What's New

New

  • Fix 42 request, sidebar and accessibility items (#38)
  • Fix the 20 most-hit problems from the UX review (#37)

Fixes

  • Show responses during tests and even out spacing (#36)
